en_title: Even the Resident Evil Movie Isn't Safe from the PlayStation Physical Disc Controversy
cn_title: 《生化危机》电影预告也被PlayStation实体版争议淹没
subtitle: 愤怒玩家把战火烧到电影区

paragraphs.en: If you thought the new Resident Evil movie trailer would be safe from the PlayStation physical disc controversy, think again.
paragraphs.cn: 如果你以为《生化危机》新电影预告能够躲过PlayStation实体光盘争议，那就再想想吧。

paragraphs.en: The latest teaser video for director Zach Cregger's live-action Resident Evil adaptation was immediately flooded with negative comments published on the PlayStation YouTube channel yesterday. It's the latest example in the weeks of outrage that have followed Sony's decision to kill support for physical discs in 2028.
paragraphs.cn: 导演扎克·克雷格执导的《生化危机》真人电影昨日在PlayStation YouTube频道发布最新预告，评论区立即被负面留言淹没。这是索尼决定在2028年终止实体光盘支持后，持续数周的愤怒浪潮又一个最新案例。

paragraphs.en: While most gamers have directed the backlash to gaming-related announcements, Resident Evil's status as a film doesn't seem to have deterred angry fans hoping to make their voices heard. Of the 1,800 comments left below the PlayStation upload for the trailer, most of the "Top" messages reference the controversy in one way or another. Some are more clever than others.
paragraphs.cn: 虽然大多数玩家把抗议集中在游戏相关公告下，但《生化危机》是一部电影，似乎也没能阻止愤怒粉丝表达立场。PlayStation上传的预告下共有1,800条评论，其中大多数「热门」留言都以不同方式提及这场争议，有些段子比另一些更机灵。

paragraphs.en: "I cannot wait to get the physical version of this," one fan, echoing the comments left on other PlayStation videos, said.
paragraphs.cn: 一名粉丝呼应其他PlayStation视频下的留言写道：「我已经等不及要买这部电影的实体版了。」

paragraphs.en: "He’s transporting the last physical game copy in existence," another joked.
paragraphs.cn: 另一人开玩笑说：「他运送的是世界上最后一份实体游戏。」

paragraphs.en: "Leon…. Where are the Physical Discs?" someone else said.
paragraphs.cn: 还有人留言：「里昂……实体光盘在哪儿？」

paragraphs.en: PlayStation social media accounts have served as a hub for fans to voice their…feelings about Sony's physical strategy since the company made its initial announcement July 1, 2026. The move will see it cease production for new physical video games starting January 2028, meaning titles launched after the cutoff date will be completely restricted to a digital release. Players, especially those who have spent the last 50ish years collecting and trading physical versions of games , aren't happy, to say the least.
paragraphs.cn: 自索尼在2026年7月1日首次发布公告以来，PlayStation社交媒体账号就成了粉丝表达自己对实体版战略……感受的集中地。索尼将从2028年1月起停止生产新游戏的实体版，这意味着截止日期后发售的作品将完全限定为数字版。玩家显然很不高兴，尤其是那些过去约50年间一直收藏和交易实体游戏的人。

paragraphs.en: After a short social media hiatus, PlayStation returned to X/Twitter and was immediately swarmed by angry comments . Every post since then has faced a similar level of backlash, with the outrage spreading to other sites, too. The Marvel's Wolverine game is the latest example of a game trailer to be flooded by those calling for change .
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation在社交媒体短暂停更后回归X/Twitter，立即遭到愤怒评论围攻。此后的每一条帖子都面临类似程度的反弹，怒火还蔓延到了其他网站。《漫威金刚狼》就是最近一支被要求索尼改变决定的留言淹没的游戏预告。

paragraphs.en: It's not too surprising to see the PlayStation upload for the Resident Evil trailer filled with comments. While the vast majority of the backlash seems to have stuck to PlayStation channels, even other comment sections aren't free from references to physical game discs.
paragraphs.cn: PlayStation上传的《生化危机》预告评论区出现大量相关留言并不太意外。虽然绝大多数反弹仍集中在PlayStation频道，就连其他平台的评论区也无法摆脱有关实体游戏光盘的讨论。

paragraphs.en: "I cant wait for the physical edition!" one viewer replied on the Sony Pictures version of the video .
paragraphs.cn: 一名观众在索尼影业版本的视频下回复：「我等不及要买实体版了！」

paragraphs.en: The Resident Evil movie is only the latest to fall victim to the controversy, but it's not the first time it's found itself in the line of fire. Longtime fans were disappointed to see Cregger had taken some creative liberties when it comes to the Raccoon City Incident when they laid eyes on its first teaser in April, for example.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》电影只是这场争议的最新受害者，但这并非它第一次陷入舆论火线。例如，长期粉丝在今年4月看到首支预告时，就因克雷格对浣熊市事件作出一些自由改编而感到失望。

paragraphs.en: The Weapons director will bring his Resident Evil to theaters September 18, 2026. For more, you can read about some of the Easter Eggs tucked into the new trailer . You can also read about , and why it's unlikely to U-turn .
paragraphs.cn: 这位《凶器》导演打造的《生化危机》将于2026年9月18日登陆影院。你可以继续了解新预告中暗藏的彩蛋，也可以阅读有关[原文此处缺失内容]，以及索尼为何不太可能改变决定的报道。

summary: 《生化危机》真人电影预告在PlayStation频道发布后，评论区被反对索尼停止实体游戏光盘的玩家淹没。1,800条评论中，大量热门留言借电影情节调侃「最后一份实体游戏」，显示争议已经从游戏公告蔓延到电影内容。
opus_summary: PlayStation玩家的实体版抗议已经烧到电影预告区。就连《生化危机》也躲不过「实体版在哪儿」的刷屏，索尼影业频道同样受到波及。
